name: Jay
source:
Stranger to the group of friends and new to the area, he was Danielle's partner for a class project and she invited him on the trip to make him feel welcome.

Jay is a boy of few words and fewer emotions, but he's not smug or insincere. On the contrary, Jay speaks only when he has something of value to say, and he means it from the bottom of his heart. However, this strange kid's guarded and mysterious demeanor make him subject to great suspicion when things start going wrong in the house, and unfortunately, he's in no rush to defend himself. Jay's strong but gentle silence hides a deep pain he can't admit to himself, much less to others, and it will take a great deal of patience and trust to bring out the man he's truly meant to be.
